attributes: Opportunity Type, Booking Target Geo (by BT RegSeg), Opportunity Source MQL Classification, Quarter(Opportunity S1 Date), Quarter(Opportunity Close Date)
goal: Monitor and optimize sales pipeline performance to drive quarterly revenue targets and booking goals.
user_context: The CMO and senior marketing executives use this dashboard during weekly and monthly executive reviews to comprehensively assess marketing and sales performance across the entire customer acquisition funnel, starting by examining quarterly booking performance against targets through the pivot table breakdown by geography and segment, then analyzing lead generation effectiveness by reviewing MQL creation trends and conversion rates through various pipeline stages (M1→S0→S1→S3→S7), evaluating marketing channel performance by comparing MQL classifications and lead source analysis to identify the most effective campaigns, monitoring pipeline health by tracking stage-specific conversion rates and identifying bottlenecks where opportunities stagnate, assessing trial-to-customer conversion rates and free trial user engagement metrics to optimize the product-led growth strategy, and finally reviewing pipeline coverage analysis to ensure adequate future quarter targets can be met, while paying special attention to regional performance variations and opportunity aging patterns to make strategic decisions about resource allocation, campaign optimization, and sales process improvements.
